CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.maan_submission_can_read(p_from date, p_to date)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare g text;
begin
 if p_from is null or p_to is null or not isfinite(p_from)or not isfinite(p_to)or p_from<date'2026-10-10'or p_to<=p_from or p_to-p_from>31 then return false;end if;
 if (select md5((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.proname,'args',pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid),'identity',pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),'result',pg_get_function_result(p.oid),'body',md5(p.prosrc),'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'language',l.lanname,'definer',p.prosecdef,'volatility',p.provolatile,'parallel',p.proparallel,'strict',p.proisstrict,'leakproof',p.proleakproof,'returnsSet',p.proretset,'kind',p.prokind,'defaults',p.pronargdefaults,'variadic',p.provariadic,'config',p.proconfig,'acl',p.proacl::text)order by p.proname)from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace join pg_language l on l.oid=p.prolang where n.nspname='private'and p.proname=any(array['begin_maan_submission_day','verify_maan_submission_hour','approve_maan_submission_day','approve_maan_submission_future','maan_submission_generation']))::text))is distinct from 'cdc808b656aa670334e65b964aac47fa'then return false;end if;
 g:=private.maan_submission_generation();if g is null then return false;end if;
 -- source_guard verifies created_at NOT NULL and therefore proves the complete
 -- all-history NULL-time population empty. A nullable schema fails the gate.
 return not exists(select 1 from generate_series(p_from::timestamp,(p_to-1)::timestamp,interval'1 day')d
  where not exists(select 1 from private.maan_submission_ready r where r.data_date=d::date and r.generation=g)
    and not exists(select 1 from private.maan_submission_future_ready r where r.singleton and d::date>=r.future_from and r.generation=g));
end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.maan_submission_fact(p newar_detail_records)
 RETURNS TABLE(record_id uuid, platform text, dataset text, source_id text, order_id text, member_id text, created_at timestamp with time zone, success_at timestamp with time zone, amount numeric, currency text, raw_provider text, paid boolean, status_known boolean, member_level integer, recharge_count integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select p.id,p.platform,p.dataset,p.source_id,coalesce(nullif(p.order_number,''),p.source_id),nullif(btrim(p.member_id),''),
 p.created_at,p.success_at,p.amount,p.currency,
 case when coalesce(btrim(p.provider),'')=''and p.channel_type='ManualRecharge'then'人工充值'else coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.provider),''),'未识别通道')end,
 p.status_group='success',coalesce(p.status_group in('success','pending','failed','rejected'),false),
 case when upper(btrim(coalesce(p.raw->>'rechargeLevel',p.raw->>'memberLevel')))~'^L(V)?[0-9]{1,4}$'
 then regexp_replace(upper(btrim(coalesce(p.raw->>'rechargeLevel',p.raw->>'memberLevel'))),'^LV?','')::integer
 when btrim(coalesce(p.raw->>'rechargeLevel',p.raw->>'memberLevel'))~'^[0-9]{1,4}$'
 then btrim(coalesce(p.raw->>'rechargeLevel',p.raw->>'memberLevel'))::integer end,
 case when btrim(p.raw->>'rechargeCount')~'^[0-9]{1,9}$'then btrim(p.raw->>'rechargeCount')::integer end
 where p.platform='MAANWIN'and p.dataset='charge'and
 (p.created_at>=timestamptz'2026-10-09 18:30:00Z'or(p.status_group='success'and p.success_at>=timestamptz'2026-10-09 18:30:00Z'));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.maan_submission_generation()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
 with snapshot as materialized(select jsonb_build_object(
 'functions',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.proname,'args',pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid),
  'result',pg_get_function_result(p.oid),'lang',l.lanname,'body',md5(p.prosrc),'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),
  'definer',p.prosecdef,'volatility',p.provolatile,'parallel',p.proparallel,'strict',p.proisstrict,'leakproof',p.proleakproof,
  'returnsSet',p.proretset,'kind',p.prokind,'defaults',p.pronargdefaults,'variadic',p.provariadic,'config',p.proconfig,'acl',p.proacl::text)order by p.proname)
  from pg_proc p join pg_language l on l.oid=p.prolang where p.oid in(
    to_regprocedure('private.maan_submission_fact(public.newar_detail_records)'),to_regprocedure('private.sync_maan_submission_fact()'),
    to_regprocedure('private.invalidate_maan_submission_ready()'),to_regprocedure('private.guard_maan_submission_control_write()'))),
 'triggers',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',t.tgrelid::regclass::text,'name',t.tgname,'enabled',t.tgenabled,
  'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid))order by t.tgrelid::regclass::text,t.tgname)
  from pg_trigger t where not t.tgisinternal and
  ((t.tgrelid='public.newar_detail_records'::regclass and t.tgname=any(array['0_maan_submission_sync_insert','0_maan_submission_sync_update','0_maan_submission_sync_delete']))
   or t.tgrelid in('private.maan_submission_facts'::regclass,'private.maan_submission_epoch'::regclass,'private.maan_submission_ready'::regclass,'private.maan_submission_future_ready'::regclass))),
 'tables',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.relname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'kind',c.relkind,'persistence',c.relpersistence,
  'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'forceRls',c.relforcerowsecurity,'acl',c.relacl::text,'options',c.reloptions,
  'policies',(select count(*)from pg_policy where polrelid=c.oid),
  'inheritance',(select count(*)from pg_inherits where inhparent=c.oid or inhrelid=c.oid),
  'rules',(select count(*)from pg_rewrite where ev_class=c.oid),
  'columns',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a.attname,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),a.attnotnull,a.atthasdef,a.attgenerated,a.attidentity,a.attcollation,a.attacl::text)order by a.attnum)
   from pg_attribute a where a.attrelid=c.oid and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped),
  'constraints',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(k.conname,k.contype,k.convalidated,k.condeferrable,k.condeferred,pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid))order by k.conname)
   from pg_constraint k where k.conrelid=c.oid and k.contype<>'n'),
  'indexes',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid),i.indisvalid,i.indisready,i.indislive,i.indimmediate)order by pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid))
   from pg_index i where i.indrelid=c.oid))order by c.relname)
  from pg_class c where c.oid in('private.maan_submission_facts'::regclass,'private.maan_submission_epoch'::regclass,'private.maan_submission_ready'::regclass,'private.maan_submission_future_ready'::regclass))
)as specification),source_guard as materialized(select
  exists(select 1 from pg_class c where c.oid='public.newar_detail_records'::regclass and c.relowner='postgres'::regrole and c.relkind='r'and c.relpersistence='p'and c.relrowsecurity and not c.relforcerowsecurity
   and c.relacl::text='{postgres=arwdDxtm/postgres,service_role=arwdDxtm/postgres}'and not exists(select 1 from pg_policy where polrelid=c.oid)
   and not exists(select 1 from pg_inherits where inhparent=c.oid or inhrelid=c.oid))
  and(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a.attname,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),a.attnotnull,a.attidentity,a.attgenerated,a.attcollation::text)order by array_position(array['id','platform','dataset','source_id','order_number','member_id','provider','channel_type','currency','amount','status_group','created_at','success_at','raw']::text[],a.attname))from pg_attribute a
   where a.attrelid='public.newar_detail_records'::regclass and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped and a.attname=any(array['id','platform','dataset','source_id','order_number','member_id','provider','channel_type','currency','amount','status_group','created_at','success_at','raw']))is not distinct from '[["id","uuid",true,"","","0"],["platform","text",true,"","","100"],["dataset","text",true,"","","100"],["source_id","text",true,"","","100"],["order_number","text",false,"","","100"],["member_id","text",false,"","","100"],["provider","text",false,"","","100"],["channel_type","text",false,"","","100"],["currency","text",false,"","","100"],["amount","numeric(24,8)",true,"","","0"],["status_group","text",true,"","","100"],["created_at","timestamp with time zone",true,"","","0"],["success_at","timestamp with time zone",false,"","","0"],["raw","jsonb",true,"","","0"]]'::jsonb
  and not exists(select 1 from pg_attribute where attrelid='public.newar_detail_records'::regclass and attname=any(array['recharge_level','recharge_count'])and not attisdropped)
  and exists(select 1 from pg_constraint k join pg_index i on i.indexrelid=k.conindid where k.conrelid='public.newar_detail_records'::regclass and k.contype='p'and k.convalidated and not k.condeferrable and not k.condeferred
   and i.indisvalid and i.indisready and i.indislive and i.indimmediate and i.indisunique and i.indisprimary and i.indpred is null and i.indexprs is null and pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid)='PRIMARY KEY (id)')
  and exists(select 1 from pg_constraint k join pg_index i on i.indexrelid=k.conindid where k.conrelid='public.newar_detail_records'::regclass and k.contype='u'and k.convalidated and not k.condeferrable and not k.condeferred
   and i.indisvalid and i.indisready and i.indislive and i.indimmediate and pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid)='UNIQUE (platform, dataset, source_id)')ok)
 select case when(select ok from source_guard)and(select md5(specification::text)from snapshot)='3a89da0beb95eff2f4238b86aaefd1db'
 and(select count(*)from private.maan_submission_epoch)=1 then md5(jsonb_build_object('formula','3a89da0beb95eff2f4238b86aaefd1db',
  'functions',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(p.oid,p.xmin::text)order by p.oid)from pg_proc p where p.oid in(to_regprocedure('private.maan_submission_fact(public.newar_detail_records)'),to_regprocedure('private.sync_maan_submission_fact()'),to_regprocedure('private.invalidate_maan_submission_ready()'),to_regprocedure('private.guard_maan_submission_control_write()'))),
  'triggers',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(t.oid,t.xmin::text)order by t.oid)from pg_trigger t where not t.tgisinternal and((t.tgrelid='public.newar_detail_records'::regclass and t.tgname=any(array['0_maan_submission_sync_insert','0_maan_submission_sync_update','0_maan_submission_sync_delete']))or t.tgrelid in('private.maan_submission_facts'::regclass,'private.maan_submission_epoch'::regclass,'private.maan_submission_ready'::regclass,'private.maan_submission_future_ready'::regclass))),
  'maintenanceEpoch',(select epoch from private.maan_submission_epoch where singleton))::text)end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.prepared_aggregate_dependency_common(p_scope text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select md5(jsonb_build_object(
  'contract','exact-prepared-dual-clock-v1',
  'functions',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc h WHERE h.oid=to_regprocedure('private.dashboard_withdraw_status_dependency_md5(pg_catalog.pg_proc)') AND md5(h.prosrc)='1cfe700c87c0fa33bee5d0586cb78853' AND pg_get_userbyid(h.proowner)='postgres' AND h.proacl::text='{postgres=X/postgres}' AND h.proconfig=ARRAY['search_path=""'] AND NOT h.prosecdef AND h.provolatile='s' AND NOT h.proisstrict AND NOT h.proleakproof AND h.proparallel='u' AND h.procost=100 AND h.prorows=0 AND NOT h.proretset AND h.prorettype='text'::regtype AND h.prolang=(SELECT oid FROM pg_language WHERE lanname='plpgsql') AND pg_get_function_arguments(h.oid)='p pg_proc') THEN private.dashboard_withdraw_status_dependency_md5(p) ELSE md5(p.prosrc) END,p.proconfig,p.prosecdef,p.provolatile,pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),p.proacl::text,(select l.lanname from pg_language l where l.oid=p.prolang),p.proparallel,p.proisstrict,p.proleakproof,pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid),pg_get_function_result(p.oid),p.procost,p.prorows)order by n.nspname,p.proname,p.oid)
   from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='private'and(p.proname=any(array[
    'dashboard_admin_live_query_raw','dashboard_admin_live_query','dashboard_admin_live_submission_analysis','dashboard_admin_live_intake_coverage',
    'dashboard_admin_live_remap_groups','dashboard_admin_live_expand_provider_filter','dashboard_admin_live_intake_order_feeds',
    'dashboard_admin_live_provider_canonical','dashboard_admin_wg_provider_aliases','dashboard_admin_live_provider_alias','dashboard_admin_live_provider_alias_values','dashboard_admin_live_confirmed_provider',
    'dashboard_data_group','dashboard_admin_fee_intervals','dashboard_admin_fee_category','dashboard_admin_ar_local_amount','provider_snapshot_dependency_token',
    'provider_snapshot_orders_raw_kernel','provider_snapshot_orders_result_kernel','provider_snapshot_submission_kernel',
    'provider_snapshot_order_feeds_kernel','provider_snapshot_intake_rows_kernel','provider_snapshot_compute_payload',
    'provider_snapshot_native_catalog','provider_snapshot_target_current','provider_snapshot_kernel_contract_current','dashboard_admin_live_platforms'])
    or p.proname like 'dashboard_prepared_%' or p.proname like 'prepared_aggregate_%' or p.proname like 'dashboard_admin_duoli_%' or p.proname like 'dashboard_admin_panda_%' or p.proname like 'dashboard_admin_wg_%' or p.proname like 'dashboard_admin_yash_%'or p.proname like 'ar_91club_submission_%'or p.proname like 'ar_submission_fact_%'or p.proname like 'maan_submission_%'
    or p.proname like 'dashboard_admin_fee_%'or p.proname like 'dashboard_admin_ar_%'or p.proname like 'dashboard_admin_order_business_%')),
  -- Fee outputs consume immutable versions, category presence and evidence eligibility,
  -- not the sheet publisher's observation/generation identity. Keep all IN directions.
  'feeSemantics',jsonb_build_object(
   'versions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v)order by v.id),'[]'::jsonb)
    from private.fee_rate_versions v where v.country=p_scope),
   'openIntervalEvidence',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(v.id,
    exists(select 1 from private.fee_rate_current_evidence e
     join private.fee_rate_generations g on g.id=e.generation_id
     join public.third_party_rates r on r.id=e.source_id
     where e.rule_key=v.rule_key and e.version_id=v.id and e.state='ready'
      and r.updated_at=g.published_at))order by v.id),'[]'::jsonb)
    from private.fee_rate_versions v where v.country=p_scope),
   'sourceCategories',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(category order by category),'[]'::jsonb)
    from(select distinct upper(btrim(r.category)) category from public.third_party_rates r
     where private.dashboard_data_group(r.country,'')=p_scope) categories),
   'blockingEvidence',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(direction,category,provider)
    order by direction,category,provider),'[]'::jsonb)
    from(select distinct bad.direction,upper(btrim(r.category)) category,r.third_party provider
     from private.fee_rate_current_evidence bad
     join public.third_party_rates r on r.id=bad.source_id
     join private.fee_rate_generations generation on generation.id=bad.generation_id
     where (bad.version_id is null or bad.state<>'ready'
       or r.updated_at is distinct from generation.published_at)
      and private.dashboard_data_group(r.country,'')=p_scope) blockers)
  )
 )::text);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.provider_snapshot_dependency_token(p_target jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select md5(jsonb_build_object(
  'contract','provider-published-v1',
  'functions',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc h WHERE h.oid=to_regprocedure('private.dashboard_withdraw_status_dependency_md5(pg_catalog.pg_proc)') AND md5(h.prosrc)='1cfe700c87c0fa33bee5d0586cb78853' AND pg_get_userbyid(h.proowner)='postgres' AND h.proacl::text='{postgres=X/postgres}' AND h.proconfig=ARRAY['search_path=""'] AND NOT h.prosecdef AND h.provolatile='s' AND NOT h.proisstrict AND NOT h.proleakproof AND h.proparallel='u' AND h.procost=100 AND h.prorows=0 AND NOT h.proretset AND h.prorettype='text'::regtype AND h.prolang=(SELECT oid FROM pg_language WHERE lanname='plpgsql') AND pg_get_function_arguments(h.oid)='p pg_proc') THEN private.dashboard_withdraw_status_dependency_md5(p) ELSE md5(p.prosrc) END,p.proconfig,p.prosecdef,p.provolatile,pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),p.proacl::text,(select l.lanname from pg_language l where l.oid=p.prolang),p.proparallel,p.proisstrict,p.proleakproof,pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid),pg_get_function_result(p.oid),p.procost,p.prorows)order by n.nspname,p.proname,p.oid)
   from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='private'and(p.proname=any(array[
    'dashboard_admin_live_query_raw','dashboard_admin_live_query','dashboard_admin_live_submission_analysis','dashboard_admin_live_intake_coverage',
    'dashboard_admin_live_remap_groups','dashboard_admin_live_expand_provider_filter','dashboard_admin_live_intake_order_feeds',
    'dashboard_admin_live_provider_canonical','dashboard_admin_wg_provider_aliases','dashboard_admin_live_provider_alias','dashboard_admin_live_provider_alias_values','dashboard_admin_live_confirmed_provider',
    'dashboard_data_group','dashboard_admin_fee_intervals','dashboard_admin_fee_category','dashboard_admin_ar_local_amount','provider_snapshot_dependency_token',
    'provider_snapshot_orders_raw_kernel','provider_snapshot_orders_result_kernel','provider_snapshot_submission_kernel',
    'provider_snapshot_order_feeds_kernel','provider_snapshot_intake_rows_kernel','provider_snapshot_compute_payload',
    'provider_snapshot_native_catalog','provider_snapshot_target_current','provider_snapshot_kernel_contract_current','dashboard_admin_live_platforms'])
    or p.proname like 'dashboard_admin_yash_%'or p.proname like 'ar_91club_submission_%'or p.proname like 'ar_submission_fact_%'or p.proname like 'maan_submission_%'
    or p.proname like 'dashboard_admin_fee_%'or p.proname like 'dashboard_admin_ar_%'or p.proname like 'dashboard_admin_order_business_%')),
  -- Fee outputs consume immutable versions, category presence and evidence eligibility,
  -- not the sheet publisher's observation/generation identity. Keep all IN directions.
  'feeSemantics',jsonb_build_object(
   'versions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v)order by v.id),'[]'::jsonb)
    from private.fee_rate_versions v where v.country='IN'),
   'openIntervalEvidence',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(v.id,
    exists(select 1 from private.fee_rate_current_evidence e
     join private.fee_rate_generations g on g.id=e.generation_id
     join public.third_party_rates r on r.id=e.source_id
     where e.rule_key=v.rule_key and e.version_id=v.id and e.state='ready'
      and r.updated_at=g.published_at))order by v.id),'[]'::jsonb)
    from private.fee_rate_versions v where v.country='IN'),
   'sourceCategories',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(category order by category),'[]'::jsonb)
    from(select distinct upper(btrim(r.category)) category from public.third_party_rates r
     where private.dashboard_data_group(r.country,'')='IN') categories),
   'blockingEvidence',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(direction,category,provider)
    order by direction,category,provider),'[]'::jsonb)
    from(select distinct bad.direction,upper(btrim(r.category)) category,r.third_party provider
     from private.fee_rate_current_evidence bad
     join public.third_party_rates r on r.id=bad.source_id
     join private.fee_rate_generations generation on generation.id=bad.generation_id
     where (bad.version_id is null or bad.state<>'ready'
       or r.updated_at is distinct from generation.published_at)
      and private.dashboard_data_group(r.country,'')='IN') blockers)
  ),
  'registry',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(country,platform,raw_provider,canonical_values)order by country,platform,raw_provider),'[]'::jsonb)
    from private.dashboard_admin_provider_registry where country in('IN','印度')and platform in(p_target->>'name',p_target->>'source_name')),
  'overrides',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(country,platform,raw_provider,canonical_provider,version)order by country,platform,raw_provider),'[]'::jsonb)
    from private.dashboard_admin_provider_overrides where country in('IN','印度')and platform in(p_target->>'name',p_target->>'source_name')),
  'confirmations',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(order_kind,order_no,confirmed_provider)order by order_kind,order_no),'[]'::jsonb)
    from private.dashboard_admin_order_provider_confirmations where source_system='AR'and p_target->>'source'='ar'and country_code=p_target->>'scope_group'and platform=p_target->>'source_name'and active),
  'currencyProof',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(source_system,country_code,platform,currency)order by source_system,country_code,platform),'[]'::jsonb)
    from public.ar_config_targets where p_target->>'source'='ar'and source_system='AR'and country_code=p_target->>'scope_group'and platform=p_target->>'source_name')
 )::text);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.withdraw_prepared_dependency()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 WITH base(token)AS(-- Exact GAME66 join-only equivalence: preserve valid published results.
